_comment: Canonical license texts for packages that declare a license but ship no license file. Used verbatim, and the notices file marks every entry that needed one so the substitution is visible rather than silent. Keyed by SPDX id; a package needing a fallback we do not have here fails generation rather than being emitted without a notice.
